{{Top|leg}}
'''Opticstalks''' were small tentacles of various lengths on the [[Ergesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' "head" enabling the plant based [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] to see. They also had similar tentacles sensitive to sound waves.
